bestBets.overview: Moe was rated Heavy 9 on Sunday after rain came through on Friday and Saturday. A little more is expected on Monday so we look bound for Heavy of some sort. The meeting begins with an 1108m Maiden. Four newcomers nommed but only two remain, BOHEMIAN BLITZ being the most notable. Fresh from their G1 success on Saturday, Jamie Mott rides for John McArdle and this 3YO has looked rock-solid in two recent jumpouts (synthetic then Heavy), albeit 2nd in both. He's not hard to like in what looks a winnable race. SHAADRILLE has had had seven hitouts since last October, two recently. Draws well and Joe Bowditch has ridden him in jumpouts. Hasn't especially trialed like a debut winner though.

raceTips.comment:
Rousley resumes for a new stable and although her race day form is plain, her jump outs for the new camp have been encouraging. Expecting improvement.

Bohemian Blitz looks the best of those on debut through the jump outs, he has been working nicely.

Blue Parrot has had a jump out between runs and might get the right run from a good gate.

The form around Jourama reads well for this but the map is awkward.
